summary.zh: 用自动指标、人工反馈与基准测试评估模型
summary.en: Measure model quality with metrics, human feedback, benchmarks

description.zh: 搭建针对 LLM 应用的评估方案，组合自动指标、人工打分和基准测试，用于版本对比与回归验证。适合上线前评估、模型替换和持续观测质量时使用。部分基准需要调用模型 API 并产生费用。
description.en: Build evaluation setups for LLM apps that combine automated metrics, human ratings, and benchmarks for version comparison and regression checks. Some benchmarks call model APIs and incur cost.
